message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis | Where to Watch |
|-------|------|----------|----------------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore’s campaign to raise awareness about climate change, featuring scientific data and personal stories. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes, Google Play |
| **“An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power”** | 2017 | A follow‑up that examines progress (or lack thereof) since the first film, with new footage from the 2015 Paris Agreement. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes, Google Play |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels the world to witness the impacts of climate change and meets scientists, activists, and policymakers. | Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, iTunes |
| **“Climate Change: The Facts”** | 2019 | A BBC production that explains the science behind climate change, its effects, and potential solutions. | BBC iPlayer, Amazon Prime Video |
| **“The 11th Hour”** | 2007 | A global perspective on environmental degradation, featuring interviews with scientists, activists, and world leaders. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes |
| **“Our Planet”** (Season 1) | 2019 | While primarily a nature series, it includes extensive segments on how climate change is affecting ecosystems worldwide. | Netflix |
| **“The Age of Consequences”** | 2020 | Explores how climate change is reshaping geopolitics, economics, and society. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes |

If you’re looking for something more recent or region‑specific, let me know and I can dig up additional titles!
